excluded_runs.reason: New shared fixture declared_rows helper and its constants were unused in the original target. Added the standard allow(dead_code) to that shared fixture module; no runtime or expected-value change.

boundaries: Complete requests still validate declared_rows against maximum_rows and require full index entry count to match expected_rows before returning any snapshot.
OwnershipStrategy is selected from completeness and explicit request authority; profile.complete retains its semantic count checks.
Legacy complete reads/projections, full checks, mutation constructors/gates and engineering preview remain materialized; index-owned page lists independently retain 4096-address ceiling.
Selected roots retain owned membership, live slot/owner, relocation, schema, key and NULL constraint checks. No fallback or new codecs.
Results and index entries remain buffered, allocated and charged. This is not streaming or constant-memory output.
Sparse fixtures have three actual rows and 5000 owned pages. Original 5000-live-row complete CLI replay is not counted here.
No Access/query/CLI compilation or native Microsoft Access execution is claimed.
original_evidence: Existing immutable V2016/V2019 inputs and public getter transcripts registered in LARGE_INDEX_SELECTIONS.md are reused unchanged; no originals generated or modified in this slice.
